svg.title: CJK Dash Width And Continuity
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 4 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: 中文破折号宽度与连续性
Chinese dash continuity is fixed through glyph width, not GSUB.
中文破折号连续性通过字宽修正，不靠 GSUB。

g.text: endash and figuredash stay one Latin cell wide.
endash 和 figuredash 仍保持一格宽。
The fix works through glyph width and outline continuity, not an emdash emdash substitution.
这个修正靠字宽和轮廓连续性，不靠 emdash emdash 替换。
